designationHistory.name: Anahuac National Wildlife Refuge
designationHistory.indexText: Established in 1963 as Anahuac National Wildlife Refuge under the Migratory Bird Conservation Act; renamed Jocelyn Nungaray National Wildlife Refuge in 2025.
designationHistory.note: The refuge page gives only the month or year. The refuge page does not say how it was established.

sources.name: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service: Jocelyn Nungaray National Wildlife Refuge, About Us
Federal Register: Texas Chenier Plain refuges draft CCP/EIS notice, Oct. 17, 2006 ("Anahuac NWR was established in 1963"; MBCA a primary authority)
White House: Executive Order 14229, Honoring Jocelyn Nungaray (2025 renaming)

review.note: Year confirmed. Adds the earlier name Anahuac NWR, which the draft left null; renamed by Executive Order 14229 (2025).

designationHistory.indexOriginal: Jocelyn Nungaray National Wildlife Refuge (originally named Anahuac) was established in 1963 to provide wintering and migration habitat for ducks and geese.
